            continue

        request_parts = request.split(' ')
        if len(request_parts) != 3 or not all(request_parts):
            malformed += 1
            continue
        path = request_parts[1].split('?', 1)[0]
        hour_key = _parse_hour(timestamp)

            continue
        status = int(status_text)

       ...
       "requests_per_hour": {hour: requests_per_hour[hour] for hour in sorted(requests_per_hour)},
    }
